name: CreateWizard
title: Blocks/Create/CreateWizard
summary: The page a first-level resource is created on one step at a time, built on the `Wizard` component: the creation header, a page heading, then the Wizard with its step rail on the start side (completed steps reachable, later ones locked), the current step's heading and fields, and its footer with Cancel, Previous and Next, Next turning into the create action on the last step. Next validates the step it leaves and stays put with the message under the field when it fails; a Review step shows the create's loading state and confirms it in a toast. Every create asks first where the resource runs: a chooser lists the hosts it can bind to, six at a time with a search, and tags the ones missing a module the resource needs; choosing one with that module off inserts a step that offers to turn it on. Each resource brings its own field steps, plus an Advanced step when the endpoint has optional settings. CreateAndDeploy is the same frame for a resource that is bound to another and deployed in one act (a service that serves a project on a domain): Project, then Domain and deployment, ending on Create and deploy. Built from `Wizard`, `PageHeader`, `SettingsRow`, `AppHeader`, `Input`, `Tag`, `Card`, `Alert`, `Field` with `Switch`, `RadioGroup` (`variant="card"`), `Item`, `Textarea`, `FieldError` and `Button`.

variants.name: ModuleOff
variants.summary: acme-staging was chosen with IP filtering off, so an IP filtering step follows Where it runs: a warning Alert, the Switch choice card that turns the module on with the list, and a note on what leaving it off means.

variants.name: ListSettings
variants.summary: The settings step of a list bound to acme-production, before Review: the Type as wide RadioGroup choice cards and the List Textarea whose label, placeholder and guidance follow the type, with Previous and Next in the Wizard footer. Next with the list empty stays on the step and shows the required message under it.

variants.name: Review
variants.summary: The Review step that closes the create, after List settings: three bands under small `Subheader`s. Where it runs is one `Alert` (success when the policy is ready, warning when it is unbound or its module stays off) with Edit back to the chooser; What gets created lists each value under its plain label (Name with its own Edit back to General), the entries as `Tag`s with a count and N more, with Edit back to List settings; What can reference it lists the consumers and the field that carries the reference. Create Access List shows its loading state and the result arrives as a toast; a value that fails on create sends the user back to its step with the message under the field.

variants.name: CreateAndDeploy
variants.summary: A resource that is useless until it is bound and deployed (Create Service): step one binds the project it serves, an existing one from the paged list or a new one configured in place (cache settings, origin); step two reads the project back with Change, then asks for the domain (a free platform-domain prefix or your own hostname, previewed as the address traffic arrives on), environment and certificate, the deployment the first release is cut against and a collapsed Advanced section. Next is gated on the project; the last action reads Create and deploy and shows its loading state, then the build logs (`detail/detail-deployment-logs#InCreateFlow`) and `create/create-deploy-success` follow.
